## Pull request overview

This PR polishes the table/grid/list UX to better match an Airtable-style experience by improving i18n coverage, enabling bulk-selection workflows automatically, and tightening table density/contrast.

**Changes:**
- Routed previously hardcoded ListView/DataTable UI strings through translation (`t()`) with fallback defaults and updated locale packs.
- Auto-enabled multi-row selection in `ObjectGrid` when bulk actions are present (without requiring explicit selection config).
- Reduced selection/row-number column widths, updated frozen offsets, improved border contrast, and fixed filler-row `colSpan` when row numbers are enabled.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Replaced toolbar/pull-to-refresh strings with `t()` calls and added fallback keys. |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Auto-enables multi-select when bulk actions exist; refactors bulk actions lookup. |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts | Adds new `table.*` and `list.*` translation keys for the updated UI strings. |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts | Adds corresponding Chinese translations for the new `table.*` and `list.*` keys. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx | Replaces hardcoded strings with `t()`, adjusts column widths/offsets, border contrast, and fixes filler-row `colSpan`. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the “Airtable UX Polish” milestone as complete and summarizes the delivered items. |
</details>

The `title` tooltip string "Open record" is still hardcoded, so it will bypass i18n and can be read by assistive tech. Route this through `t()` (with a fallback default) similarly to the visible "Open" label.

`table.modified` is defined as `"{{count}} row modified"`, but the UI now passes arbitrary `count`, which will produce incorrect English for plural counts. To match existing repo patterns (e.g., `list.recordCountOne`), add a singular key (like `table.modifiedOne`) and update the UI to choose the correct key based on `count === 1`, or change the translation strategy to support plural forms consistently.
```suggestion
    modifiedOne: '{{count}} row modified',
    modified: '{{count}} rows modified',
    selectedOne: '{{count}} item selected',
    selected: '{{count}} items selected',
```

New behavior auto-enables `selectionMode = 'multiple'` when bulk actions exist, but there isn't a test asserting that (1) checkboxes appear when `batchActions`/`bulkActions` are provided without any explicit selection config, and (2) the bulk action bar can be triggered by selecting rows. Since `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/row-bulk-actions.test.tsx` already covers bulk actions, adding an explicit test for this auto-enable path would prevent regressions.

The row number header currently renders a literal "#". If the goal of this PR is full i18n compliance for surface-visible text, this should also come from translations (or at least be configurable), since it is visible UI text in the header. ```suggestion {t('dataTable.rowNumberHeader', '#')} ```
